mapper.select: select (select count(*) from user where registration_date >= CURDATE()) as userCountToday, (select count(*) from lecture l join lecture_status ls on l.lecture_status = ls.no where l.lecture_status = 1 and l.upload_date >= CURDATE()) as lectureRequestCountToday, (select count(*) from user u where u.user_type = 2 and u.registration_date >= CURDATE()) as providerApplyCountToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE write_date >= CURDATE()) AS postCountToday, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_report WHERE report_date >= CURDATE()) AS reportedPostCountToday;
